name: Babbling
overview: Scripture warns against babbling, highlighting the folly of excessive and foolish speech. Proverbs teaches that a prating fool brings about his own downfall and that the multitude of words often leads to sin, whereas wisdom is shown by restraint and prudent speech. The tongue of the wise uses knowledge rightly, but fools pour out foolishness, and idle talk tends toward poverty rather than profit. Thus, biblical wisdom values careful, measured speech over reckless or incessant babbling.
